Etiology
Acute coronary syndrome is a term used to describe the con-
dition of persons who present with either an acute MI or un-
stable angina. An estimated 879,000 persons were discharged
from hospitals in 2003 with acute coronary syndrome.8 Th e
causes of an acute MI or unstable angina are plaque erosion, 
rupture of a plaque resulting in formation of a thrombus, and 
vasoconstriction. Over half (55%–60%) of sudden cardiac death
